invariants.rationale: HoodieListData.lazy returns a HoodieData object (never null) constructed from 'records'.
The method always returns HoodieListData.lazy(records), which produces a HoodieListData.
HoodieListData.lazy should preserve the contents of 'records'; collectAsList() is expected to yield the input list.
The method is only called with a non-null 'records' argument, as it is immediately passed to HoodieListData.lazy, which would throw otherwise.
